title: Sustainability at Exia: Our Promise to the Planet
summary: How we think about packaging and ingredients, and the small choices that add up.
body:
At Exia Organics, we believe that beauty shouldn't come at a cost to the earth. That's why sustainability sits at the core of what we make.

## Ethical sourcing

We prefer suppliers who look after their soil and pay fair wages, so the communities behind our ingredients are cared for too.
